title: Watermelon Pictures Plans Film Partnership With Qatar
excerpt:
The company is exploring a strategic co-production arrangement with Qatar's Film Committee.
Specific projects and final agreements have not yet been announced.
body_md:
Watermelon Pictures and the Film Committee at Media City Qatar have announced plans for a strategic partnership to develop and co-produce films featuring perspectives from the Global South. The proposed collaboration would bring together Qatar's growing production infrastructure and the company's distribution experience and relationships with filmmakers.

Founded in Chicago in 2024 by Badie Ali and Hamza Ali, Watermelon Pictures has primarily focused on distribution. Its recent slate includes The Voice of Hind Rajab, El Sett, Who Killed Alex Odeh? and American Doctor. The proposed arrangement signals an ambition to take a larger role in developing and producing films.

Potential projects could shoot substantially in Qatar or be structured as Qatari co-productions. The partners also hope to involve local post-production companies, support regional crews and explore access to Qatar's screen production incentives.

The announcement was made during Doha's film industry events, but the partnership remains subject to definitive agreements and required approvals. Individual films, creative teams and release dates have not yet been confirmed.
